Mode is separate from physics settings; changed mode rebuilds records before new optical rows; unchanged mode is noop
Partial contacts, old public wrapper, per-row ownership and upload/shader source remain unchanged

modeInvalidationReason: updateRecords does not call the window writer; it recreates private current records at the same committed time and increments recordsGeneration. New p identities invalidate opticalView/contact caches, while body anchor cache also tests generation. Switching assignment follows that refresh; old rgbTaps are never repopulated in place. Invalid mode rejects before mutation; same mode does not refresh.
sourceScope: New constructor default summary and separate getter/setter; two full-support opticalViewRecord sites. Partial contact/force-partition optical records retain the old public window API. No shader, kernel, bins, mass, I0, physics or audio rewrite.
decision: Candidate withdrawn because complete CPU-flow evidence was mixed; exactness is not performance admission. No new native A/B is justified by these reports.
